{"loc":"TABATABAI:15:9#3","rows":[{"verses":["15:9"],"words":["ٱلذِّكْرَ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The present Qur'an loses none of the meanings of remembrance: its many teachings all recall God and constitute the purpose of calling it dhikr.","anchor":"ففي جميع ذلك ذكر الله، وهو الذي يرومه القرآن بإطلاق القول بأنه ذكر، ونجد ما بأيدينا من القرآن لا يفقد شيئا","mentions":[]},{"verses":["15:9"],"words":["ٱلذِّكْرَ"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Fussilat says falsehood cannot prevail over or enter the Qur'an at any time through nullification, abrogation, or distortion that would erase its character as remembrance.","anchor":"لا يغلبه باطل ولا يدخل فيه حالا، ولا في مستقبل الزمان لا بإبطال ولا بنسخ ولا بتغيير أو تحريف","mentions":["41:40","41:41","41:42"]},{"verses":["15:9"],"words":["ٱلذِّكْرَ","لَحَٰفِظُونَ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The unrestricted wording of remembrance and preservation means God protects the Qur'an against any addition, omission, or change of wording or order that would destroy its remembrance of Him.","anchor":"فقد أطلق الذكر وأطلق الحفظ فالقرآن محفوظ بحفظ الله عن كل زيادة ونقيصة وتغيير في اللفظ أو في الترتيب","mentions":[]},{"verses":["15:9"],"words":["لَهُۥ"],"type":"referent","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"The pronoun in lahu cannot refer to the Prophet: the context shows that the polytheists mocked him because of the Qur'an he claimed was revealed to him.","anchor":"ومن سخيف القول إرجاع ضمير \\" له \\" إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فإنه مدفوع بالسياق","mentions":["15:6"]},{"verses":["15:9"],"words":["لَحَٰفِظُونَ"],"type":"theology","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The revealed Qur'an is divinely guarded from additions, omissions, and changes, as promised to the Prophet;
